# LED Headlight Bulb Upgrades

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Insert a Katana 9007 LED Bulb into the passenger side headlight, pushing the fan housing firmly up against the plastic retainer. [t720]

## Tools

- [Partial] Battery [t720]

## Parts

- Katana 9007 LED Bulb [t720]

## Tips & gotchas

- Push the fan housing of the bulb firmly up against the plastic retainer to lock it flush. [t720]
- Remove the DRL relay for Canadian models if experiencing flickering. [t720]
